name: Library of Congress API
tagline: Search LOC collections, Chronicling America newspapers, and catalog records as JSON.
description: Public JSON APIs from the Library of Congress for searching digital collections, bibliographic catalog records, and Chronicling America historic newspapers. Most endpoints are free and require no API key; they return structured JSON for items, search results, and newspaper pages from loc.gov holdings.

auth.details: No authentication required for public LOC JSON APIs; requests are unauthenticated HTTP GET.

use_cases: search Library of Congress digital collections by keyword
fetch catalog metadata for a LOC item by ID
query Chronicling America historic newspaper pages
list LOC collection items with JSON facets and pagination
